reading.body:
Gil Cisneros's AI record is mostly small-business AI bills, with two $1,000 Amazon PAC contributions and one vote on an AI kill switch bill.

The pattern is narrow. Seven of the thirteen events are cosponsorships, and most of those bills name small business in their titles: the SBA AI Adoption Reporting Act, the Small AI Innovators Empowerment Act, the AI for Main Street Act, the AI-WISE Act. The recorded votes follow the same thread, including a Yea on H.R. 5764, the AI for Main Street Act, after cosponsoring it. The one item that points elsewhere is the AI Kill Switch Act cosponsorship in July 2026, which is a different kind of bill from the rest.

The two Amazon PAC contributions are the only money in the record, both $1,000, in June 2025 and May 2026. They are small and they come from a single donor, so they show a relationship exists but not what it bought. The dates place them near the small-business AI bills without establishing any link, and the page itself says placement is not a claim of causation.

What this does not cover matters. There is no data on committee assignments, no floor speeches, no lobbying contacts, and no spending by AI companies other than Amazon. It also says nothing about data centers, power, or compute, which is where the binding constraints on AI actually sit. A reader looking for a legislator's position on grid capacity or chip policy will not find it here.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Gil Cisneros: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 13 events.
